question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT sr.name as sales_rep, r.name as region, SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY sr.name, r.name
),
max_sales AS (
    SELECT region, MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT r.name as region, COUNT(o.id) as num_orders, SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT rt.region, rt.num_orders, rt.total_sales, rs.sales_rep, rs.rep_total_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN max_sales ms ON rt.region = ms.region
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rt.region = rs.region AND rs.rep_total_sales = ms.max_rep_sales
ORDER BY rt.region, rs.rep_total_sales DESC

    SELECT sr.name as sales_rep, r.name as region, SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY sr.name, r.name
),
max_sales AS (
    SELECT region, MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT rsales.region, rsales.sales_rep, rsales.rep_total_sales, ms.max_rep_sales
FROM rep_sales rsales
JOIN max_sales ms ON rsales.region = ms.region AND rsales.rep_total_sales = ms.max_rep_sales
ORDER BY rsales.region, rsales.rep_total_sales
